rows.commentary: 14.6: Deepti Sharma completes a immaculate maiden over as Josephine Nkomo pushes the final delivery directly back to the bowler.
15.1: Vaishnavi Sharma comes over the wicket, floating it outside off for Modester Mupachikwa to tap towards cover point.
15.2: Modester Mupachikwa dances down the track aggressively, launching Vaishnavi Sharma over mid-on for a boundary.
15.3: Vaishnavi Sharma adjusts with a fuller, quicker delivery that catches Modester Mupachikwa's inner half toward mid-wicket.
15.4: Modester Mupachikwa drives firmly along the ground to mid off.
15.5: Vaishnavi Sharma outsmarts Modester Mupachikwa with turn and flight, allowing Yastika Bhatia to complete a simple stumping.
15.6: Vaishnavi Sharma attacks from over the wicket with a flat delivery on the stumps, safely defended by Chiedza Dhururu toward point.
16.1: Deepti Sharma loops this delivery close to off stump, drawing Josephine Nkomo onto the front foot to bunt it firmly away to the right of the bowler.
16.2: Josephine Nkomo charges down the pitch, nudging it toward mid-on with soft hands for a sharp single.
16.3: Chiedza Dhururu swings hard at a wider delivery from Deepti Sharma but finds only empty air.
16.4: Chiedza Dhururu presses forward watchfully to block Deepti Sharma on the front foot.
16.5: Chiedza Dhururu plays tentatively off the inside half toward mid-wicket, deciding against the single.
16.6: Deepti Sharma loops it slower through the air, drawing Chiedza Dhururu into a front-foot drive that catches the outside edge and races past first slip for a brace.
17.1: Jintimani Kalita watches Josephine Nkomo push it in front of point, where a rejected single and a near-miss direct hit leave the batter scrambling safely back.
17.2: Jintimani Kalita pitches it up around middle and leg, allowing Josephine Nkomo to clip it firmly through mid-wicket for a single.
17.3: Jintimani Kalita errs in her line, sliding this delivery down the leg-side to signal a wide.
17.3: Jintimani Kalita charges in, drops it short, and Chiedza Dhururu ruthlessly pulls it away toward backward square leg for a cracking boundary.
31.2: Vaishnavi Sharma lands one that grips and turns sharply past Nyasha Gwanzura's outside edge as the batter pokes from the crease.
31.3: Vaishnavi Sharma creates a chance as Nyasha Gwanzura slaps it toward mid-off where Harmanpreet spills the catch, allowing two runs.
31.4: Vaishnavi Sharma slows the pace down through the air on off stump and Nyasha Gwanzura safely gets behind it to defend.
31.5: Vaishnavi Sharma drops it slightly short, prompting Nyasha Gwanzura to carve the delivery directly into the off-side.
31.6: Vaishnavi Sharma tosses it up and Nyasha Gwanzura unleashes a brutal heave over mid-wicket all the way to the boundary fence.
32.1: Kranti Gaud tests Josephine Nkomo outside off, inducing an inside edge that agonizingly misses the timber and races away for four.
32.2: Kranti Gaud delivers on a length around middle and leg, clipped straight to the mid-wicket fielder by Josephine Nkomo.
32.3: Kranti Gaud gets one to keep slightly low, forcing Josephine Nkomo to block defensively from deep within her crease.
32.4: Kranti Gaud angles a back-of-a-length delivery outside off, which Josephine Nkomo smoothly carves toward the point fielder.
32.5: Kranti Gaud keeps it fractionally short outside off, allowing Josephine Nkomo to pat the ball softly in the direction of point.
32.6: Kranti Gaud claims the prized wicket of Josephine Nkomo as a top-edge from a pull shot is safely pouched by Jintimani Kalita running in from fine leg.
33.1: Vaishnavi Sharma floats it up around middle and leg, and Nyasha Gwanzura firmly pushes the ball straight back down the pitch.
33.2: Vaishnavi Sharma tosses it up on middle and leg, and Nyasha Gwanzura safely pushes it right back down the surface.
33.3: Vaishnavi Sharma loops up a fuller delivery outside the off-stump, which Nyasha Gwanzura guides cleanly into the off-side.
33.4: Nyasha Gwanzura clears her front leg and hammers the ball back past the bowler, only for mid-on to execute a sharp stop.
33.5: Nyasha Gwanzura clears her front leg to slog a tossed-up leg-side delivery powerfully over mid-on, sending it racing away for a boundary.
33.6: Vaishnavi Sharma seals a brilliant five-wicket haul as Nyasha Gwanzura plays across the line, dragging an inside edge off her shoe and onto the stumps.
